title: Widen typo-RAM objects from observed base+offset spans; address-as-value rewrite compiles; prove in progress, not installed
scope: Emulator only. No hardware flash. No git commit. Official opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin not touched. Tree controller_init.c, em9305_ram.h, and g2-em9305.ld were left at the proven pre-widen state (ld writer approval unused this turn because nothing was installed). Other streams' Renode runs were left alone.

method.sources_harvested: all g2/src/em9305/**/*.c for spans; rewrite applied only to controller_init.c
method.span_sources: *(T*)(var+N) and *(T*)var when var is assigned a 0x80 address; 0xADDR+index*STRIDE with index<N from the same function or file-wide fallback; memset/memcpy numeric sizes; read_config destination lengths
method.pinned: objects are not grown into the stock .bss.stock_* / QP / myapp / 0x80fe20..0x810000 ranges
method.alignment: typed fields only when addr is naturally aligned for the type (structs are not packed). Unaligned observed accesses still widen the object span but stay as raw casts.
method.rewrite_rule: address-as-value and table bases become (uintptr_t)&object or (uintptr_t)&object + off, so later root+N is bounds-checked against the whole widened object, not a 1-byte field

examples.em9305_ram_8015c4: size 1 -> 32; covers the >=24-byte record at 0x8015c4 (uint16 at +0, uint32 at +8/12/16/20) that failed the previous &field pass
examples.em9305_ram_803d58: new, size 5448; covers 0x803d58 context table plus 6 * 784-byte records starting at 0x803d78 (index<6) and adjacent fields

remaining_0x80_literals.note: All remaining are pinned stock cells (0x801398, 0x802d20/0x802fe0/0x8032a0, 0x802a60/0x8035dc/0x80389c), the 0x80000000 sign bit, 0x80200005 encoding, or a CRC table constant 0x806567cb — not untyped application RAM.
